messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging Priya K (on-call): multiple customers reporting elevated 429s after today's rl-v3 canary rollout in us-west-2. Aggregated spike at 11:27 UTC. Auto-alert: ratecap-exceeded (5xx/4xx ratio), affected services: api-proxy, token-accounting. Please ack.
Priya K: acked. looking now. any idea which change went out in the canary? :thinking_face:
Jesse O: Triaging — canary diff shows 'exemptions-v2' flag turned on by default for canary group, but rollback/compat path was missing token-mapping for legacy accounts. might be dropping exemptions. grabbing logs.
Marta L: I'm seeing a surge of 429s tied to route /v1/generate for customers with reserved capacity tags. tokens counted fine but exemption check returns false for those ids.
Priya K: timeline — when did canary deploy start? deploy-bot?
deploy-bot: deploy rl-v3-canary started at 11:20:03 UTC on us-west-2 (job #4921). Canary targets 3% traffic.
Sam R: I can flip the feature flag to return to previous behavior if we want a quick mitigation. We should consider rollback if flip doesn't stabilize.
Jesse O: Can we flip exemptions-v2 to false for canary only? That should restore legacy path without full rollback.
Priya K: Do it. Also route traffic away from canary in the load balancer if spike continues. Sam, flip please and post the flag command.
Sam R: running: `redwood feature toggle exemptions-v2 --env=canary --set=false --region=us-west-2` (exec 11:31:12 UTC)
Sam R: flag flipped. waiting for propagation (30s). :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Marta L: Within logs, I still see failing checks for a subset of tokens — looks like token accounting microservice returns 404 for tenant mapping after the new code path was introduced.
Priya K: Are those customers on Dedicated? need CS heads-up.
CS-Escalations: getting alerts from those accounts. putting account managers on notice. prepping a short note to affected customers: "We are investigating increased throttling; mitigation in progress." draft ready if you want to send after stabilization.
Jesse O: I can patch token-accounting quickly — the issue is an env var name change: LEGACY_TENANT_MAP vs TENANT_MAP. Canary pod env didn't include the alias. Patch in PR now.
Priya K: Good catch. For now, did flag flip reduce 429 rate? metrics?
Marta L: Dashboard shows 429 rate down ~60% after flip. Not back to baseline yet but trending. Some residual errors from the instances that had already evaluated requests with new path.
Sam R: I'm starting a partial rollback of the canary to cut traffic to 0 while we validate the token-accounting fix: `deploy rollback rl-v3-canary --to=0% --region=us-west-2` (exec 11:33:50 UTC).
IncidentBot: rollback initiated by Sam R at 11:33:50 UTC. Notifying devs and on-call.
Priya K: Good. Jesse, how long for hotfix PR to merge and rollout to canary pods? We want to validate before re-enabling.
Jesse O: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/891 — small env var alias and an extra integration test. Need a quick review from Marta and then will merge. ETA 12m.
Marta L: Reviewing now. test failure in auth mock fixed. LGTM. Approving.
Jesse O: Merged and initiating a canary redeploy with the env alias. `kubectl rollout restart deploy/token-accounting -n canary-us-west-2` (11:42:10 UTC). Rolling pods...
Marta L: Monitoring logs — new pods are healthy and token mapping requests return 200 for the previously failing tenants.
Priya K: Any continued customer impact visible on CS side?
CS-Escalations: CS update: error rates dropping; we've held off external comms until baseline. We'll send an "incident resolved" note once 429s are back to normal for >10min.
Sam R: Canary traffic back to 3% gradually after verifying fix at 11:46:00 UTC. No spike detected. I will re-enable exemptions-v2 for canary with the env alias in place.
Sam R: toggling: `redwood feature toggle exemptions-v2 --env=canary --set=true --region=us-west-2` (11:48:05 UTC)
Marta L: After re-enable, metrics stable. No regression in the last 6 minutes. Rolling into small increase of token requests but within SLO.
Priya K: Great. I'll keep monitoring for 30m then mark incident as mitigated if stable. Jesse, add postmortem notes about env var aliasing and missing integration test for canary env.
Jesse O: Will do. Drafting runbook action items: 1) Validate feature flags in canary include backwards-compatible env aliases, 2) Add integration test that exercises exemptions path for legacy tenants, 3) Add dashboard alert for sudden jump in 429s tied to exemptions check fail.
IncidentBot: Incident labeled: ratecap-canary-exemption-mismatch. Severity: sev2. Pager cleared for on-call at 11:52:00 UTC (auto-clear after mitigation).
Priya K: CS, please send a short post-mitigation note: "We saw a canary rollout introduce an exemption check regression causing temporary throttling for a subset of customers. A rollback and hotfix were applied; normal service restored by 11:48 UTC. No data loss. Contact us for follow-up." Keep tone apologetic but factual.
CS-Escalations: Sending now. I'll attach a short timeline and point contacts for customers who need deeper RCA.
Sam R: Leftover action: schedule a canary dry-run step that runs integration validations before enabling exemptions-v2. I'll add ticket in infra board.
Marta L: I'll run a backfill on logs to quantify total requests impacted and list of tenant IDs to include in postmortem. ETA 2h.
Jesse O: Postmortem draft will be ready for review by EOD. Thanks everyone for fast coordination. :thumbsup:
Priya K: Marking incident mitigated in Slack. I'll keep watch for follow-ups. Closing thread in 30m if no new signs.
